commonRules: Write the case-map tests of the mandate FIRST, under exactly the titles docs/design/B08-case-map.md cites, and see them fail before building.
Real PostgreSQL 17 for every database claim through the runtime login roles; the superuser only as oracle; never a database fake.
Interleavings by hold points and lock waits observed in pg_stat_activity; never a sleep.
Every lifecycle instant is kauro.server_now(); tests stand in the past only through the labelled TEST CLOCK (D8-CLOCK-1).
A fake has exactly one owner (D8-FAKE-1), reports evidenceClass SIMULATED with contract-fake-* tokens, lives on a test-only testing subpath and is bound by no composition root.

Keep pnpm run verify green: the matrix owner rows and served inventory of what the mandate adds, runtime-boundary.json re-read and reviewed entry by entry when grants change, OpenAPI regenerated when routes change.
When the mandate lands, its case-map rows lose PLANNED and gain the commit; the status table follows.
Commit with the owner's identity and the attribution lines of the session; never push; never write the earlier product name.
